Select compounds with IC50 measurements in nM against human Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to obtain canonical_smiles as an INNER JOIN. Join docs on activities.doc_id to obtain pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to obtain compound_key. Filter by target_dictionary.pref_name = 'Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic' and target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens' and activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
